title: [Epic] Studio designs, Setup administers (ADR-0146): one editor per metadata item, in-place customization on read-only packages, the paired `<base>.customize` package, the metadata catalog moves into Studio
body:
director#1 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CaRN6wdrRyLKJSCMYH

Epic: ADR-0146 rollout · `pm:epic` · opened by the project decision thread 「决定 Studio 建议三行的产品取舍」 on the maintainer's word 「同意，立专题卡」 (2026-10-30T13:22Z), after 「按照这个方案先更新 issue，写adr。等我审核」 (10:28Z). The record is **ADR-0146 (Proposed), draft PR #28045** — the maintainer's hand-merge is its acceptance (Prime Directive #14). ⛔ Not a claim.

**Blocked-by: PR #28045.** ⛔ Until ADR-0146 merges, no seat claims this epic and no child card is cut from it; the phase lists below are the plan of record, not cards. The row rulings already executing on #27356 (row 12 → PR #28076, merged; row 19 A1 Delete flow, seat `domain:ui#3`) stay on #27356 and are **not** children of this epic.

Territory (declared): `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/**` (pillars, rails, switcher, landing), `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/**` (the catalog that moves), `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/setup/**` (Packaged automation page; the new administration pages), `ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useStudioDesignGate.ts`, `packages/runtime/src/flow-clone.ts` and `packages/runtime/src/domains/{automation,packages}.ts` (the clone door's target package; the paired-package create convention), `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-package-install.ts` (explicit namespace on the paired create), `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/{studio-authoring,ux-conventions}.json`, `ui/e2e/live/studio-object-designer.spec.ts`. Server children go to the `domain:server` queue; the rest are `domain:ui`.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 按 ADR-0146 分三期落地「Studio 管全部元数据、Setup 只做管理」：② 只读包上就地覆盖 + 流的账本开关与克隆放项上 + 配对定制包 `<base>.customize` 当一个界面看；③ 元数据目录 / 源码 / 分层 / 历史 / 诊断从 Setup 搬进 Studio，Setup 补职位持有人与权限集分配两页，Setup → Metadata 路由重定向，QA 清单与 e2e 改门；④ 其余类型按需进支柱。
- **为什么改：** HotCRM 走查（#27356 行 12/14/19）：同一条流两个设计器两种保存、代码包没有 Studio 入口、删除 / 重置 / 开关 / 克隆只在 Setup、客户定制没有家。你 10-30 的裁定见 ADR-0146 D1–D7。
- **风险与回滚：** 每张子卡独立 PR，可单独回退；目录搬家（③）前 Setup 页保留，搬家用重定向，不删路由。
- **先看：** ADR-0146 的 D2（§9 三样提起）、D3（配对包 + 显式 namespace）、D4（账本开关的权限边界）；本卡的第二期 6 张。
- **两分钟验证：** 第二期完成后：打开 HotCRM（只读）→ 任一视图可改并出现「已自定义」+ 重置；任一流可「在本部署关闭」与「克隆」；克隆落在 `hotcrm.customize` 并混排在 HotCRM 的 rail 里。
- **需要你做的：** 先 hand-merge #28045；合并后由协调员 / 本线程切第二期子卡进各车道队列。

## Phase 2 — customization on the read-only package (6 children; cut after #28045 merges)

| # | Child (one card each) | Lane | ADR | Depends on |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2a | In-place overlay editing on a read-only package's overlay-type item (views, dashboards, reports first; translations and email templates after): draft writes the overlay row, publish applies; "customized in this environment" chip from the layered read; **Reset to package default** (the existing `DELETE /meta/:type/:name`, honest verb from `resettable`); retire the row-13 link to Setup | `domain:ui` | D2 | — |
| 2b | Activation-ledger switch and **Clone** on a read-only package's flow in the Automations pillar: switch bound to `GET /automation/_status` + `POST /automation/<name>/toggle`, worded "off for this deployment", distinct from the writable package's definition switch; disabled from the served posture facts (`features.tenancyPosture`, `user.isPlatformAdmin`) with the console's wording, server refusal shown verbatim after an attempt; Clone via `POST /automation/<name>/clone` with the server notice and the "switch the original off" offer (objectui#13270) | `domain:ui` | D4 | 2c for the clone's landing |
| 2c | Flow clone door takes a target `packageId` (a writable package) and refuses a package-less target once 2d exists; closes the ADR-0070 D5 gap (clones no longer land in the retired scope) | `domain:server` | D3 | — |
| 2d | Paired-package create convention: `POST /packages` (and the install primitive) accept `<base>.customize` — dependency on the base in `manifest.dependencies` (ADR-0141), **`namespace` set to the base's explicitly** (the id-derived default would be `customize`), idempotent create-if-absent; one `packages/spec` constant for the pairing that the door and the console both read | `domain:server` (+ `domain:spec` for the constant) | D3 | — |
| 2e | Studio shows base + `<base>.customize` as one surface: mixed rails with a "customization" chip and an "only customizations" filter; New / Clone land in the paired package without a prompt; pending-changes and publish act on the paired package; the switcher folds the paired package under its base; contributed items from other packages greyed with their source | `domain:ui` | D3 | 2d |
| 2f | Studio landing: one line per package — overlaid count and switched-off count (served rows and ledger rows; nothing computed) | `domain:ui` | D3 | 2a, 2b |

## Phase 3 — the catalog moves (4 children; cut after Phase 2 lands)

| # | Child | Lane | ADR |
|---|---|---|---|
| 3a | Re-home `views/metadata-admin` directory, lists, generic item page (schema form, Source JSON, layered diff, history, diagnostics, reset/delete) under Studio's **All metadata** area, per package and across packages; a pillar type opened from the directory opens its pillar | `domain:ui` | D1 |
| 3b | Setup administration pages: **position holders** (from `PositionHoldersSection`) and **permission-set assignment** (from `AssignedUsersSection`) as people-and-organization pages under `setup.access`; queue membership arrives with ADR-0142 D2, not here | `domain:ui` | D7 |
| 3c | Setup → Metadata routes redirect into Studio; the Setup item pages for the seven pillar types stop editing; Packaged automation stays as the deployment-wide operations overview until the maintainer decides its retirement (ADR-0146 open question 1) | `domain:ui` | D1, D4 |
| 3d | QA checklist and e2e: items driving the Setup designer as "a sibling door onto the same save" (`studio-authoring.json`, `ux-conventions.json`, `studio-object-designer.spec.ts`) rewritten to the Studio door or marked transitional | `domain:ui` (docs/qa) | Consequences |

⛔ 3c does not retire a route whose administrative action has no Setup home yet (3b first).

## Phase 4 — as pulled (direction only, no cards here)

App, action, dataset (today a create dialog, no designer), translation, email template, documentation and the AI types gain pillar-grade designers one card at a time; until then the All-metadata area's generic page is their editor.

## Not in this epic

- #27356 row 12 (browse entry, D5) — merged as PR #28076. Row 19 A1 (Delete flow) — seat `domain:ui#3` on #27356. Row 14 — will not do (letter C).
- Any change to the overlay tier's membership, the activation ledger's shape, or clone lineage (ADR-0005, ADR-0126 §9 second bullet).

## Dedupe

Open `domain:ui` / `area:studio` titles read for "Setup designer", "one designer", "customize package", "overlay in Studio", "Open in Studio": none covers this plan. Related, not duplicates: #27356 (the source rows), #27928 (row 20 nav-contributor stamp, server), #26889 (contributed interfaces listing), #27842 / #27504 (switched-off packaged action), #12049 (ADR-0126's charter card).

Links back: ADR-0146 (PR #28045), #27356, ADR-0126 §7.4 / §9, ADR-0070 D3 / D5, ADR-0141, ADR-0142.
Size: XL across phases; each child S–M.
